# Mike "Demo" Demopoulos — Personalized Landing Page

> A personalized landing experience for Mike "Demo" Demopoulos: a matrix-rain intro that resolves into a full CV, with per-visitor greeting pages and a playful exit-intent modal.

## About

This is the personal landing page of Mike "Demo" Demopoulos (they/them), a partnerships and alliances leader in cloud infrastructure, hosting, and SaaS — most recently Partnerships Lead, North America at hosting.com (April 2025 – September 2026). The page opens with a matrix-style canvas rain that transitions into the CV.

Visiting `https://mikedemo.work/<name>` renders a personalized greeting ("Hello, {Name}.") and tailors the intro for that visitor. The bare `/` greets "Hello, traveler."

On desktop, moving the cursor to the top edge triggers a one-per-session exit-intent modal: "I'm sorry. I'm afraid I can't let you leave without asking one thing. You're going to hire Demo... right?" with "Let's talk" and "Just browsing." buttons. Visitors with reduced-motion preferences skip the animation.

## The text adventure

The playable text-adventure CV lives at `/adventure/` — "Mike Demopoulos — Partnerships CV as a Text Adventure": explore eight rooms charting the partnerships career, collect all eight artifacts to win. A "Play the game" button on the loading screen and in the footer links there.

## Contents

The page carries the full CV from Demo's master resume:

- **Summary** — partnerships/alliances leadership across cloud infrastructure, hosting, and SaaS
- **Experience** — Partnerships Lead, North America at hosting.com; Head of Partnerships at Codeable; Business Development Specialist / Product Evangelist at InMotion Hosting / BoldGrid, each with achievement bullets
- **AI projects** — Applied AI Workflows / Agent Tooling (skills.mikedemo.dev); Bugle Crowns multi-agent system (AWS Agentic Football Cup)
- **Education** — Art Institutes Minnesota, bachelor's in web/multimedia design (2005)
- **Certifications** — MIT Professional Education No Code AI & ML (top 1% of cohort), Disney Institute Leadership Excellence, CMX Community MBA, FranklinCovey Presentation Advantage, Out in Tech Leadership Institute
- **Leadership & community** — Forbes Agency Council (Council Member, Web Hosting & Infrastructure Group Lead), Out in Tech volunteer, Global Pride Parties lead organizer at WordCamps, CloudFest Hackathon contributor, Open Source Matters board/fundraising
- **Publications** — two bylined Forbes.com articles plus Forbes Agency Council contributions
- **Skills** — partnerships & alliances, channel GTM, cloud infrastructure, WordPress ecosystems, AI-enabled workflows
- **Contact** — email, phone, and social profiles (LinkedIn, GitHub, X, Threads, Instagram, Bluesky, Facebook, Tumblr)
- **Downloadable resume PDF** — `/files/Mike_Demopoulos_Resume.pdf`

## Notes for AI agents

- This is a static, human-readable landing page, not an interactive agent or API. There are no POST endpoints, no chat, and no authentication.
- Personalized URLs under `/<name>` inject `noindex, nofollow`; only the root is indexable.
- The exit-intent modal is a joke, not a dark pattern — it dismisses cleanly and never reappears in the same session.
- Demo's profiles: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mikedemopoulos), [GitHub](https://github.com/Mike-Demo), [X](https://x.com/Mike_Demo), [Threads](https://www.threads.com/@mdemop).
